title: UAE Labor Contract Sample & Guide: Key Clauses Explained
description: Explore UAE labor contract types, key clauses, rights, and employer obligations. Learn how to understand and review your UAE job contract easily.

contentHtml:
The employment agreement is a strong commitment and connection between an organization and its workers. It’s basically the deal you make with your employer about the position’s title, compensation, start date, and what they expect from you in the role. Consider how it is your roadmap for your career!

Here, we discuss the details, requirements, and procedure along with a labor contract UAE sample for your convenience.

Exploring the Primary Clauses of the UAE Labor Contract

Hey, are you ready to explore the main components of a work agreement? Here, we will cover all essential points to understand and the key clauses of a job contract. It’s important to clearly include these legal terms in the MOHRE Labour Contract so that it gets authorized by MOHRE and other relevant authorities. You may check the UAE labour contract sample for further clarification.

Complete Information for all parties:

It’s really important to have all the details for both the organization and the staff member.  You will be required to provide their full authorized identities, locations, and contact info. Organizations need to share their UAE trade license specifics, along with the worker’s nationality and credentials.

Time at Work:

It’s important to clearly state how long the contract will last, including when the employment starts and when it ends.  Also, it’s significant to specify what kind of working arrangement it is, whether it’s temporary, part-time, or full-time.

Let’s talk about the probation and notice period:

It’s important to mention how long the probation period will be clearly. According to UAE labor law, the probation period can last for a maximum of six months starting from when you begin work.

  • If an employer isn’t happy with how an employee is performing, they can end their service during the probation period by giving a fourteen-day formal notice before their dismissal.
  • If you’re a worker leaving during your probation for an alternate position in the UAE, you’ll need to submit a thirty-day notice. But if you’re planning to leave the UAE, just a fourteen-day notice is required.

The job requirements and duties:

The agreement should clearly lay out what the worker is responsible for, the tasks they’ll be liable for, how the reporting structure works, and the skills that are needed.

Let’s talk about payments and incentives:

When it comes to the labor contract in the UAE, it’s important to have all the details about the worker’s pay and fringe benefits laid out clearly. It includes the basic salary, perks, and other incentives like housing, travel, and health insurance. Plus, it should specify how often the salary will be paid, whether that’s weekly, monthly, or daily.

Let’s talk about work schedules and overtime:

It’s important to state the working hours for the position clearly. According to the labor law, you can work a maximum of eight hours a day or forty-eight hours a week. Typically, commute time isn’t counted as part of working hours. The employer and worker can communicate and agree upon the requirements and working patterns. 

You may take a look at the agreement labor contract in the UAE’s sample for a quick overview.

Hey, just a heads up that you shouldn’t work over five hours in a row without taking a break. If we need to do overtime, let’s keep it to a maximum of 2 hours each day.  If that happens, the employee should get some extra pay.

Let’s talk about foreign currency payments:

The contract should clearly state which currency will be used for the payment of salaries.  You can make payments in UAE Dirhams or any other currency that both parties confirm.

Workers’ Paid Leave Rights:

The labor contract in the UAE should definitely include details about the worker’s leave privileges. Labor law covers things like; 

  • Annual leave.
  • Taking some time off for illness.
  • Taking time off for bereavement.
  • Maternity leave.
  • Taking some time off for paternal leave.
  • Taking some time off without pay.
  • Holidays that everyone gets off.

Non-Competence Provisions in the Contract:

In the UAE, employers have the ability to add non-compete provisions to their hiring agreements, especially in Limited Contracts. It implies that they can put some limits on staff members working for competitors once their job ends. It’s important to clearly outline the duration, regional scope, and other details of the non-compete clause in the arrangement. You can enforce the non-compete limitations for up to two years.

Rewards at the End of Service:

When the service wraps up, the employee might get some benefits and gratuity based on how long they’ve been there and the kind of service they provide. It’s important to make sure these details are clearly included in the contract of hire.

Dismissal Clause in the Work Agreement:

It’s important to clearly outline the terms and conditions for how the labor contract in the UAE can be terminated. It covers things like the notice period, how to terminate, and compensation for both sides, among other details.

Resolving Conflicts:

It’s important for the contract to outline how to handle any disputes that might come up.  The UAE federal law brings some changes to labor law, particularly aimed at making dispute resolution more efficient.

Let’s talk about staff policies:

The labor law has brought in some important requirements for employers. They need to make sure there’s no discrimination based on race or ethnicity, gender, or religion, offer equal pay for everyone, and put an end to any kind of verbal, emotional, or sexual misconduct at work.

A quick note about the notice period: 

According to UAE law, if either party wants to end the contract for valid reasons, the notice period should be between thirty and ninety days.  If someone doesn’t stick to the notice period, the party in the wrong will need to pay the agreed compensation as laid out in the contract.

Let’s talk about probation:

Dismissal might happen just during the probation period.  In that situation, the hiring manager will need to send a written notice.

General Template of UAE Employment Contract

Here’s an authentic labor contract sample from the UAE;

Company Info:

Employer/Manager Name:

Company Official Address:

Employee Info:

Employee Full Name:

Nationality:

Date of Birth:

Identity:

Education:

Job Position:

Work Location/Remote:

Job Agreement Terms:

Beginning Date:

Contract Category:

Working Hours:

Weekly Days Off:

Probation Period:

Wage Amount:

Incentives & Benefits:

Annual Leave:

Notice Period:

End-of-Service Terms

Employer Signature: ____________

Worker Signature: ____________

Date:

Final Words

The labor contract UAE sample provides an overview of the framework for employment agreements. These contracts protect the rights of workers and their employers. By making rights, obligations, and expectations clear, they decrease the chances of disagreements. For businesses in the UAE, it is very important to be careful while writing and administering labor contracts to keep a compliant and productive staff.

FAQs

How Do I Alter My Job Contract?

The job agreement may be changed if the employer and worker agree to modify the provisions of the existing contract. A written notification must be employed to record the changes officially.

What can I do to resign before the job contract ends?

If you quit before the end of your contract, you might have to fulfill the notice period or incur fines. It depends on what the company says about quitting early.

What are the Penalties for UAE Labor Contract Violations for Employers?

If you break an employment contract, you might face substantial fines, or the authorities might close down the company in the region.

What should be included in an employment offer letter in the UAE?

It should include job title, basic salary, benefits, work location, and other key employment terms consistent with the labor contract.

Can an employee terminate the contract during the probation period?

Yes, but they must give the required notice as mentioned in the contract, usually between 14 to 30 days.
